description: Lifecycle hooks configuration for CogainCore in Codex CLI

hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$cmd = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($cmd -match 'dotnet\s+ef\s+(migrations\s+add|database\s+update)') { Write-Error 'CRITICAL: Automatic EF migrations are strictly prohibited in CogainCore. Please ask the developer to execute database migrations manually.'; exit 1 }"
hooks.statusMessage: Enforcing CogainCore EF migration safety policy
